Module-R HVAC Units (Video)
Module-R HVAC Units
Key Facts:
Application: Tent and container HVAC units
Type: compact or split system
Cooling capacity: 5 kW, 7 kW, 10 kW, 12 kW, 15 kW
Heating capacity: 5 kW, 7 kW, 10 kW
Refrigerant: R134a
Colour: RAL 6031 NATO oliv, other colours available on request
Description:
Module-R is a line of robust military compact and split HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) units for tent and container applications. The standard modular system offers a wide range of adaption options for your application. The units are suitable for extreme operating temperature ranges of -32 °C to over +55 °C, for this reason the weisstechnik tent HVAC units are used in military field camps in all climate zones.
The Module-R tent solutions are available in three different housing sizes with a performance range from 5 to 15 kW cooling capacity and 5 to 10 kW electrical heating capacity.
Due to the intelligent CAN-Bus technology, the HVAC units can operate individually or in complex networks with several tent air conditioning units controlled by one control panel. For this purpose, there are two different control panels available, which have been specially developed for the extreme environmental conditions in military field camps.
Please contact us for further information.
Please give a try to our Module-R product configurator, you can quickly and easily configure an air conditioning system for your specific application and needs.
Additional features available:
Soft starter for low current compressor start
Electric heater with greater heating power
Integrated fuel heater
Customized air distribution system
Environmentally friendly refrigerant
